summary: 28-year-old with recurrent headache and transient hemiparesis, resting lactate 3.8 mmol/L, ragged red fibres on biopsy, m.3243A>G confirmed. Maternal hearing loss.
45-year-old with bilateral ptosis and restricted eye movements, ragged red fibres present, no stroke-like episodes, lactate normal.
34-year-old with corneal clouding, carpal tunnel syndrome, joint stiffness and normal intellect; enzyme assay confirmed alpha-L-iduronidase deficiency.
38-year-old with three years of episodic abdominal pain, normal imaging, hyponatraemia during attacks, urine darkening on standing; urinary porphobilinogen markedly raised.
